dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: My family name is Goth, get the picture?

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: My father is the general manager of the Goth Grand Hotel.

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Don't be fooled by his Mr. Nice Guy act — he's being completely obstinate and unreasonable on the matter of my marriage!

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: That's why all I can do in the middle of the night is to... to— Wait a moment, you haven't been sent by him to get me talking, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Marvin
dialogues.text: Go away, get out of here. I am wide awake, I'm not in the slightest bit sleepy... *yawn*
